messages:
June (Solutions Eng): FYI forwarded from AE — Peregrine Dataworks needs a short runway for a multi-region POC tomorrow: split routing (EU + South Africa), temp per-route concurrency bump to 40 for 48h, and three CIDRs whitelisted for peering. They also raised renewal cost concerns. Assigning @Olivia (CS) for the commercial sync and @Ravi (Support Ops) for config.
Olivia (CS): ACK. Do we have the CIDRs and exact start window?
June (Solutions Eng): Yep — CIDRs: 41.79.0.0/16, 197.210.0.0/16, 3.120.45.0/24. Requested start 2025-06-18 09:00 UTC, 48h. They mentioned KMS/HSM for a private deployment later this quarter.
Ravi (Support Ops): I can take routing + whitelist. Need an approval path for the per-route concurrency bump—this fits our temp-capacity playbook. Tagging @infra-bot to check headroom.
infra-bot: Capacity check queued. Dedicated pool headroom in eu-west-1: 12% (sufficient for a +40 concurrency bump for 48h if we reserve 4 gpus). Suggested action: submit reservation request.
Ravi (Support Ops): Cool. I'll submit the reservation and create a short-lived policy `pdw-temp-split`. Will include automatic fallback to standard model variant if capacity drops.
Olivia (CS): I'll book a pricing call with AE + customer tomorrow 08:30 UTC. They flagged renewal in Q3 as at-risk unless we show controls: caching, KV warmup, model-quantization options and a per-route cost projection.
June (Solutions Eng): For infra ticket, here's a routing snippet you can paste — keeps it minimal:
```
routing_policy: pdw-temp-split
rules:
  - region: eu
    route: eu-edge-v2
    concurrency_limit: 40
  - region: af-south
    route: sa-edge-canary
    concurrency_limit: 40
whitelist:
  - 41.79.0.0/16
  - 197.210.0.0/16
  - 3.120.45.0/24
window: 48h
auto-revoke: true
```
Ravi (Support Ops): Copied into infra ticket #4321. ETA to complete infra prep: ~2.5 hrs. I'll DM June when it's ready for verification.
Olivia (CS): Also capturing feedback — they asked for clearer per-route cost estimates in the Console (per-route projections + caching impact).
June (Solutions Eng): Filed FEAT-1208 for "per-route cost projection" — https://redwood.internal/FEAT-1208 (internal).
Olivia (CS): If infra finishes early, we can kick KV warmup: `kv-warmup --target pdw-temp-split --duration 30m` to reduce cold-start token costs.
Ravi (Support Ops): Will coordinate warmup with runtime team. Also need to validate KMS onboarding steps — can tenant be prep-added to our KMS allowlist? @security-bot any quick wins?
security-bot: KMS onboarding requires signed MSA + key policy. Noted and routed to security team. Will confirm timeline.
Olivia (CS): One more ask from Peregrine — they want audit/logs during the 48h window and a copy pushed to their S3. Can infra enable per-tenant token-level logs for the window? @infra-bot
infra-bot: Yes — can enable detailed logs. Add param `enable_detailed_logs: true` to infra ticket #4321 and provide S3 destination + IAM role.
Olivia (CS): Great. I'll send calendar invite and the pricing prep doc to AE + customer. Also we'll include cost-control recommendations in the meeting to reduce renewal risk. :pray: 
Ravi (Support Ops): Understood — starting reservation now. Will update thread when warmup/whitelist live.
June (Solutions Eng): Thanks team — please mark aut revocation for 48h window and close infra ticket after logs + whitelist verified.
Olivia (CS): Closing loop once customer call done. Recording feedback into CS notes and FEAT-1208 for product team.
summary: Coordination for Peregrine Dataworks POC: regional split, temp concurrency bump, CIDR whitelist, KMS onboarding, logs, and renewal risk / pricing call
